#Loading Packages and Data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(rstatix)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggsignif)
library(ggpubr)
library(Hmisc)
library(emmeans)
library(broom.mixed)
library(dplyr)

Plaque_Quant <- read_csv("hAPP-J20 Plaque Count and Area.csv") %>%
  select(
    Animal_ID,
    Genotype,
    `Age_months`,
    ROI,
    `Average_Plaque_Number_(mm2)`,
    `Average_Area_(%)`)

Plaque_Quant <- Plaque_Quant %>%
  rename(Avg_Plaque_Number_mm2 = `Average_Plaque_Number_(mm2)`,
    Avg_Plaque_Area_pct   = `Average_Area_(%)`)
```

#Calculating Mouse Means for each ROI
```{r}
mouse_means <- Plaque_Quant %>%
  group_by(Animal_ID, ROI, Age_months, Genotype) %>%
  summarise(
    Average_Plaque_Number = mean(Avg_Plaque_Number_mm2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Average_Plaque_Area   = mean(Avg_Plaque_Area_pct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop")

mouse_means <- mouse_means %>%
  mutate(
    Genotype = factor(Genotype, levels = c("WT", "Het")),
    Age_months = factor(Age_months, levels = c("6", "9")),
    ROI = factor(ROI))
```

#Two Way Anovas
```{r}
anova_number <- mouse_means %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  anova_test(
    dv = Average_Plaque_Number,
    between = c(Genotype, Age_months))

anova_number

anova_area <- mouse_means %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  anova_test(
    dv = Average_Plaque_Area,
    between = c(Genotype, Age_months))

anova_area
```

#Tukey Post Hoc Tests
```{r}
Post_Hoc_Tukey_Number <- mouse_means %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  tukey_hsd(Average_Plaque_Number ~ Genotype * Age_months) %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)

Post_Hoc_Tukey_Area <- mouse_means %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  tukey_hsd(Average_Plaque_Area ~ Genotype * Age_months) %>%
  filter(p.adj <= 0.05)
```

#Mixed Effects Model Plaque Number
```{r}
lmm_num <- lmer(
  Average_Plaque_Number ~ Genotype * Age_months * ROI + (1 | Animal_ID),
  data = mouse_means)

summary(lmm_num)
anova(lmm_num, type = 3)

posthoc_num_gen <- emmeans(lmm_num, ~ Genotype | Age_months * ROI)
pairs_num_gen <- contrast(posthoc_num_gen, "pairwise", adjust = "tukey")
pairs_num_gen


posthoc_num_age <- emmeans(lmm_num, ~ Age_months | Genotype * ROI)
pairs_num_age <- contrast(posthoc_num_age, "pairwise", adjust = "tukey")
pairs_num_age
```

#Mixed Effects Model Plaque Area
```{r}
lmm_area <- lmer(
  Average_Plaque_Area ~ Genotype * Age_months * ROI + (1 | Animal_ID),
  data = mouse_means)

summary(lmm_area)
anova(lmm_area, type = 3)

posthoc_area_gen <- emmeans(lmm_area, ~ Genotype | Age_months * ROI)
pairs_area_gen <- contrast(posthoc_area_gen, "pairwise", adjust = "tukey")

posthoc_area_age <- emmeans(lmm_area, ~ Age_months | Genotype * ROI)
pairs_area_age <- contrast(posthoc_area_age, "pairwise", adjust = "tukey")
```

#Plaque Number Graphs
```{r}
het_age_effects_number <- Post_Hoc_Tukey_Number %>% 
  filter(
    ROI %in% c("RSC"),
    group1 == "Het:6",
    group2 == "Het:9") %>%
  select(ROI, p.adj)


sig_df_number <- mouse_means %>%
  filter(Genotype == "Het", ROI %in% c("RSC")) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(
    y_max = max(Average_Plaque_Number, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  left_join(het_age_effects_number, by = "ROI") %>%      # <-- ADD P-VALUES HERE
  mutate(
    x_start = 6.2,
    x_end   = 9.2,
    y       = y_max * 1.08,
    label = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"))

mouse_means <- mouse_means %>%
  mutate(Age_months = as.numeric(as.character(Age_months)))

Average_Plaque_Number_Plot <- ggplot(mouse_means,
       aes(x = Age_months,
           y = Average_Plaque_Number,
           colour = Genotype)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
               size = 5,
               shape = 18) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl,
               fun.args = list(mult = 1),
               geom = "errorbar",
               width = 0.15,
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  facet_wrap(~ ROI, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(
  breaks = c(6, 9),
  limits = c(5.5, 9.5)) +
  labs(x = "Age (months)",
       y = "Average Plaque Number",
       colour = "Genotype") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 18) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    WT  = "#8F8AE5",
    Het = "#E54B77")) +
  # horizontal bracket
  geom_segment(
    data = sig_df_number,
    aes(x = x_start, xend = x_end, y = y, yend = y),
    linewidth = 0.6,
    colour = "Black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # asterisks
  geom_text(
    data = sig_df_number,
    aes(x = (x_start + x_end) / 2, y = y * 1.03, label = label),
    size = 6,
    colour = "Black",
    inherit.aes = FALSE)
Average_Plaque_Number_Plot
ggsave("Average_Plaque_Number_Plot.png", width = 18, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

#Plaque Area Graph
```{r}
het_age_effects_area <- Post_Hoc_Tukey_Area %>% 
  filter(
    ROI %in% c("DHipp", "RSC"),
    group1 == "Het:6",
    group2 == "Het:9") %>%
  select(ROI, p.adj)

sig_df_area <- mouse_means %>%
  filter(Genotype == "Het", ROI %in% c("DHipp", "RSC")) %>%
  group_by(ROI) %>%
  summarise(
    y_max = max(Average_Plaque_Area, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(het_age_effects_area, by = "ROI") %>%      #Adds p-values
  mutate(
    x_start = 6.2,
    x_end   = 9.2,
    y       = y_max * 1.08,
    label = case_when(
      p.adj < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.adj < 0.01  ~ "**",
      p.adj < 0.05  ~ "*",
      TRUE          ~ "ns"))

       aes(x = Age_months,
           y = Average_Plaque_Area,
           colour = Genotype)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",

               size = 5,

  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_sdl,

    aes(x = (x_start + x_end) / 2, y = y * 1.03, label = label),
```
